description: Bright enamel game icons for the SD lobby. Existing assets preserved.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent lobby icon for the Korean SD survival game Seoul Hero, displayed at only 72–127 px.
Primary request: Replace heavy realistic metal lobby graphics with a bright, cute, light game icon.
Style: polished hand-drawn cartoon game icon, large rounded simple shapes, a clean medium-thick navy outline, flat two-tone fills with a small enamel highlight and gentle volume. Match a chibi mobile game. NOT realistic, NOT paper cutout, NOT dark military metal.
Palette: warm ivory dominant, pale mint secondary, deep navy contour, small warm gold accents. Keep the overall icon bright.
Composition: exactly ONE icon subject, centered, unobstructed whole silhouette, 12 percent transparent margin, square canvas. Crisp and readable at small size, no frame, no circular background, no floor or background shadow.
Background: true transparent alpha.
Text: none. Avoid letters, words, numbers, watermark, busy detailing, photorealism, distressed texture.
Subject: A cozy modern Seoul guild headquarters as a tiny rounded two-storey building. Ivory walls, broad mint roof trim, two warm golden windows, a simple mint diamond sign, a small green plant. Clearly a friendly headquarters, almost a toy building.
